title: Modes of Analyzing Disinformation Narratives With AI/ML/Text Mining to Assist in Mitigating the Weaponization of Social Media
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates how AI models (ChatGPT vs Conspiracy AI) handle anti-semitic and neo-Nazi prompts. It also discusses the religious motivations of Gab's leadership to create a 'Based AI' for the 'glory of God' and to communicate the 'Truth of the Gospel,' presenting these as part of an ideological and religious value system in AI development.
